# catl check

Validate schemas, paths, and lockfile integrity

Validates all manifests against their collection schemas, checks path
invariants, verifies tree hashes, and validates vendor directories.
Exits 0 with no output on success (Unix rule of silence).

**Category:** Catalog \
**Aliases:** `catl c`, `catl validate`

## Usage

```bash
catl check [flags]
```
